messages:
maria: Heads up — deploy-bot has a scheduled helm chart bump: infra/api-chart -> 2.3.0 targeting prod regions (us-west, eu-west, ap-south) in the 23:00 UTC change window. Canary = 10% for 15m per region. Pls ack if you can watch metrics and logs.

deploy-bot: Release scheduled: infra/api-chart@2.3.0 · canary(10%) · regions: us-west, eu-west, ap-south · window: 2025-07-21T23:00Z · id=rel-20250721-48a1

sam: ack. I'll run preflight checks and watch canary dashboards (errors, p99, connection counts).

alex: quick note — values change includes db.pool.maxConnections increase and a new featureFlag:enable_new_agg. Watch DB connections and txn timeouts.

jia: running preflight (helm diff + crd validate) in eu-west now. posting output shortly.

jia: preflight output: 
```
DIFF: infra/api-chart/templates/crd.yaml
- apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1beta1
+ apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
ERROR: CRD conversion webhook requires apiextensions.k8s.io/v1 support on server
```
This cluster appears to be on older k8s (1.20) where our CRD uses v1, conversion fails. Canary would likely 404 on webhook.

sam: canary in eu-west must be blocked — that webhook failure is a hard stop. @deploy-bot please pause region eu-west for this release.

deploy-bot: pausing region eu-west for release rel-20250721-48a1. Canary will not start there. Other regions unchanged.

maria: decision: do a staggered rollout. Proceed with canary in us-west and ap-south. Pin eu-west to latest stable chart (2.2.8) until CRD/operator fix. Update release notes to reflect partial regional rollout and rollback runbooks.

alex: pin instructions for eu-west: 
```
helm upgrade infra/api-chart oci://registry.redwood/infra/api-chart --version 2.2.8 \
  --namespace prod --kube-context eu-west --set image.tag=sha256:abcd1234
```
Also ensure values override file uses `db.pool.maxConnections: 200` (current stable) not the new 250.

jia: create a quick patch to avoid webhook by disabling conversion in eu-west CRD? That’s risky. Better: roll operator to a compat build. Eng-platform: can you confirm operator version?

eng-platform: confirming — eu-west is running operator v0.9.1 which doesn't support the new CRD v1 schema. We'll prepare v0.10.0 hotfix that adds v1 support and roll it through a short maintenance window. ETA ~45m.

release-ops: noted. I'll mark eu-west as blocked in the release tracker and add an entry in release notes: "Regional partial rollout: eu-west pinned to 2.2.8 pending operator/CRD update; other regions upgraded to 2.3.0 canary."

sam: monitoring playbook for the ongoing canaries (us-west, ap-south): alert if 5xx rate rises >2% sustained over 5m OR p99 latency >400ms. On alert: run `kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/api --watch` and be ready to rollback.

alex: rollback command (if canary fails): `helm rollback infra/api-chart --namespace prod 1` (assuming release history entry 1 = 2.2.8 stable). Keep exact revision handy in the runbook.

maria: I'll send an all-hands note to svc-owners and update the release-ticket with the stagger plan and the pin for eu-west. Also creating a follow-up ticket to backport the CRD fix for long-term.

release-ops: making the tracker change now and adding links to logs/dashboards.

eng-platform: starting operator hotfix rollout plan for eu-west. Will coordinate with sam for a short 10m maintenance window — target +50m.

maria: summary: staggered rollout approved. eu-west pinned to 2.2.8 (manual pin applied). continue canary in us-west + ap-south. operator/CRD fix in progress for eu-west, ETA ~45m. rollback/playbook in place. I'll update release notes and call out partial-region status. :white_check_mark: 

sam: standing by on paging channel. :eyes: 

jia: logging the preflight failure and attaching diffs to the release ticket.

maria: thanks everyone — keep this thread for updates only. If anything on-call, escalate via #incidents.
